initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is -0.10, but the table and arithmetic checks do not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R293-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect of observed training access. The observed risk difference, 0.70 − 0.80 = −0.10, is descriptive; the average causal risk difference is not uniquely determined.
